card.name: Endings of invented brand names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a word that is split into parts, such as the ending of a brand-name drug or a rare name. Often seen in 'on<<itis>>' (colitis, pneumonitis) and in made-up drug names just before 'is contraindicated'.

modes.label: Brand-name drug endings
modes.description: Final piece of a coined drug brand name, often followed by a verb or capsule/contraindication wording.

modes.description: The 'itis' ending of inflammation terms such as colitis or pneumonitis, written as 'on' plus 'itis'.

modes.label: Rare names in other text
modes.description: The closing piece of a taxonomic family or a place name split into parts.

card.plain: It fires on the last piece of a long or unusual name that has been split into parts, mostly drug brand names and -itis terms.
